article.title: Five Rivers reps defect to APC
article.text: Five members of the House of Representatives from Rivers State on Tuesday defected from the Peoples Democratic Party to the All Progressives Congress. They include Hon. Ekpenyong Bassey-Ita, Hon. Tamuno Briggs-Fictional and Hon. Ngozi Amadi-Okafor. Their letter was read by the Speaker at plenary.
